TaskDescription: Continuous ICU EEG monitoring of a comatose patient after cardiac arrest. No task was performed.
RescaledChannelsNote: Channels whose full int16 physical span did not fit EDF's 8-character header field; their EDF physical range covers the actual data extent instead, preserving physical values at full int16 resolution but not the source digital codes.
MissingSampleHandling: Samples flagged missing in the source WFDB data (digital code -32768) were filled with the ADC-zero physical value; per-channel counts are in channels.tsv.
UnitsNote: The source WFDB records declare unit 'nu' (unitless). Values here are the gain/baseline-rescaled signals, as produced by the official PhysioNet Challenge 2023 loader; their empirical amplitude distribution is consistent with microvolts, and they are labelled uV on that basis. Treat absolute amplitudes with caution.
